profile.name: Kamran Alam
profile.title: Full Stack Developer · Backend Focused
profile.tagline: I build secure, well-structured REST APIs and the React apps that use them. Node.js, Express, MySQL and PostgreSQL in production.
about: I'm a Full Stack Developer at Viva Organization, where I joined as an intern and was promoted to a full-time role. I own the backend and frontend of three production applications: Clinic Management, GST Billing and School Management.

My day-to-day is backend work: designing REST APIs, JWT authentication and role-based access control, relational schemas in MySQL and PostgreSQL, and query tuning. On one set of endpoints, that tuning cut average response time by 30%.
I graduated with a B.Tech in Computer Science from Galgotias University (CGPA 7.93) and have solved 350+ DSA problems across LeetCode and GeeksforGeeks.

points: Promoted to full-time after the internship; own end-to-end delivery of backend and frontend modules across 3 production applications (Clinic Management, GST Billing, School Management).
Implemented JWT authentication and role-based access control (RBAC) middleware across 4+ user roles.
Optimized MySQL and PostgreSQL queries, reducing average API response time by 30%.
Deploy and maintain the applications on VPS servers with cPanel; write Jest unit tests for core API logic and debug production issues in an Agile/Scrum team.
Developed backend and frontend modules for the Clinic Management, GST Billing and School Management systems.
Designed, built and integrated 10+ REST APIs for appointments, billing, GST invoicing, authentication, student registration and fee management, cutting manual billing and invoicing effort by 40%.

projects.title: Enterprise School Management System
projects.subtitle: Multi-role school ERP
projects.description: A production-oriented school management system with a secure backend: academic structure, student registration, fee collection, attendance and reporting.
highlights: JWT authentication with RBAC across 3 roles (admin, teacher, staff)
Normalized MySQL schema for academic years, classes, sections and 500+ student records
8+ REST APIs for onboarding, fees, attendance and academic workflows, with referential integrity enforced in the database
Dashboards for fee status and academic performance across 10+ classes and sections

projects.title: SmartExpense
projects.subtitle: Personal finance tracker
projects.description: A full-stack expense tracker with secure authentication and analytics dashboards for income, expenses and monthly trends.
highlights: JWT authentication with bcrypt password hashing
6+ modular REST APIs for income, expenses, categories and reports
Interactive Recharts dashboards for monthly and per-category trends

projects.title: ChatWave
projects.subtitle: Real-time secure chat
projects.description: Real-time chat over Socket.IO with JWT authentication stored in HTTP-only cookies.
highlights: HTTP-only cookie sessions to keep tokens out of JavaScript

highlights: Filtering across 3 priorities and 4 status states
